cliPath.description: Path to the openclaw binary used for the Judge call and the push. Default 'openclaw' (resolved from PATH).

dbPath.description: SQLite registry path. Default <openclaw state dir>/goal.db.

defaultMaxTurns.description: Default turn budget for a new goal. Default 20.

dryRun.description: When true, log what would be pushed but do not push. Default false.

enabledAgents.description: Optional allowlist of agent ids this plugin acts on. When empty, all agents are covered.

judgeModel.description: Model for the Judge (one-shot call). Default openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free (free OpenRouter tier).

judgeFallbackModels.description: Models tried in order after judgeModel when the Judge call fails on transport (429, timeout, CLI error). Empty (default) means the built-in default judge model is the fallback, so a configured judgeModel that 429s still degrades to a known-good model.

judgeTimeoutMs.description: Judge call timeout in ms. Default 120000. The Judge is a model call on a loaded VM (~60-70s); the agent_end hook is fire-and-forget, so the Judge may run longer than the ~30s hook budget.

maxJudgeOutages.description: Consecutive judge outages before the goal pauses. Default 3.

maxParseFailures.description: Consecutive unparseable judge outputs before the goal pauses. Default 3.

maxStalledTurns.description: Consecutive no-progress turns before the goal pauses. Default 5.

pushTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for the push agentTurn. Default 300.

nudgeEnabled.description: Enable the periodic goal driver that nudges every non-complete goal's owning session. Default true.

nudgeIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between driver scans of the goal registry. Default 30.

nudgeInitialDelaySeconds.description: Delay before the first driver scan after the gateway starts. Default 120.

reflectorEnabled.description: Grade turn-ends and validate wait/complete requests in the agent's standing reflector session (agent:<agentId>:goal-reflect) instead of the one-shot judge; an agent's wait/complete is recorded as a pending request and the goal status flips only on the reflector's approving verdict. Default true.

pushRoute.description: How pushes (continuations, nudges, denials) reach a session: 'api' = api.session.workflow.scheduleSessionTurn (in-process, gateway Cron owns the turn); 'cli' = the openclaw agent subprocess. Default 'api'.

verdictTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a reflector evaluation may run before the one-shot judge fallback resolves it. Default 300.

description: Per-session goal ownership: the agent declares its goal, a judge audits it at every turn-end, and an unreached goal pushes a continuation prompt into the idle session.
name: Goal
